entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I'm calling because I need to return something. It's a pair of cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF789012.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now. Before we go further, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's just... they're not working for me. I've tried to make them work, I really have. I adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but I keep getting horrible blisters on every ride. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I understand the frustration.
I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I saved up for these. I was just hoping I could get my money back. I really needed this to work out.

I understand completely. Let me just check the policy for your order... Okay, I see you received the shoes 76 days ago. The good news is that our policy for standard items like these cycling shoes is a 90-day return window. You're well within that timeframe.
Wait, really? So I can still get a refund?

Yes, absolutely. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email on file. Just pack the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Oh, thank you, Alex! That is such a huge relief. I was so worried I was just stuck with them. Thank you so much.

You are very welcome, Sarah. We appreciate your loyalty. Once our warehouse receives the return, your refund will be issued to your original payment method in about 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful.
I'm happy I could help. Have a great rest of your day.
